notes.title: Shogun Showdown 1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is it—Shogun Showdown 1.0 is now available on PC and consoles, with a 10% launch discount here on Steam and awesome bundles!

[h2]What's new in the 1.0 version:[/h2]

[h3]Summary:[/h3]

[list][*] Final ascension: Day 7
[*] New hero: The Chain Master
[*] New location: Ieyasu's Garden
[*] New content: 7 tiles, 7 skills, 5 quests, 3 new enemies...
[*] New initial deck
[*] New lore[/list]

[previewyoutube=Y1sJu_B1NFY;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

[h3]Full Patch Notes:[/h3]

[expand type=details expanded=false][h3]New content[/h3]
Final ascension: Day 7
New elite type
New enemy
???
New Hero: The Chain Master.
New location: Ieyasu's garden + new boss (Ieyasu the Patient)

New skills:
[list][*] Rogue Retail
[*] Seiryu's Scale
[*] Fenghuangs's Feather
[*] Two-Faced Dancer
[*] Overflow Guard
[*] Chilling Combo
[*] Odd Curse[/list]
New quests:
[list][*] Rising Sun
[*] Untold Legends
[*] True Skills
[*] Ultimate Arsenal
[*] True Mastery[/list]
New tiles:
[list][*] Hookblade
[*] Nagiboku
[*] Sharp Turn (replaces Turn Around)
[*] Ki Push (replaces Kayteryuken)
[*] Thorns
[*] Back-Smoke Bomb
[*] Chakram[/list]
New starting deck: random deck
New Stats page in camp archive
New upgrade: "+1 Upgrade Slot, -1CD"
New enchantment: "Curse, +2CD"
New buttons "Restart" and "Back to camp" after game over
New Lore
[list][*] Small cutscenes after defeating a day for the first time (can also be accesssed from the main menu: Other -> Endings)
[*] Reworked boss barks and descriptions[/list]

[h3]Balance tweaks[/h3]
Signature Move buff (7CD -> 5CD)
Shadow Kama debuff (2CD -> 3CD)
Reduced probability of offering an enchant upgrade you already have in your deck
Scale "+1 upgrade slot" upgrade probability based on how many maxed-out tiles you have
Slighly decreased probability of -1CD upgrade
Slighly decreased coins and edamame drop chance on day 1 & 2.
In Moonlit Port Shop, the "skull services" are only offered if you have unlocked all unlockables. Furthermore, blood services are always part of the pool.
Skull exchange in moonlit port debugg: 15$ -> 10$.
Combo coin skill no longer works for summoned enemies (avoid infinite coin-farming)
Rearranged order of unlocks
New alt-deck for Jujitsuka
Fumiko and Sato now give 5 coins as reward, like Statue and Kowa (before they gave 10).
Grappling hook is now compatible with double strike.
Prevent '+1 upgrade slot' and 'sacrifice tile' to appear in Shogun Castle reward.
2x damage from curse is processed after skills bonuses are applied (instead of before, which made for some unexpected damages)
Strategist ultimate stamp is now 800 turns instead of 900
Dancer shop buff: Two-way Move and Damaging Move skills no longer add +1CD to your special move
Warrior's gamble in shops: 5$ instead of 10$
Can use Kami Brew out of combat if you have the Shield Retention skill

[h3]Polish / visuals[/h3]
Animated title screen
Colored icons for shops in map
In Shops, auto-hide long shrine descriptions when you highlight held skills (so that the skills are no longer hoplessly hidden beghind the shrine description)
In Shops, show level of skills on sale if it's a "level up for a skill you already have"
Reworked combo VFX
Polished up the camp environment
New graphics for Moonlit Port Shop
Rearranged order of tiles in Camp Archive
Map: gamepad/keyborard-only button prompt for location selection
Reworked Shadow Kama attack animation
Reworked Tanageshima attack animation
Reworked Crossbow attack animation
Reworked Arrow attack animation
Reworked Blade of Patience attack animation
Reworked Swirl attack animation
Reworked Katana attack animation
Polished quests notification UI
Reworked graphics of "Charge" and "Back Charge" tiles.
New "unfreezable enemy" effect[/expand]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44828/Shogun_Showdown__Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44552/Position_is_EVERYTHING/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41792/Goblinz_Best_Sellers/

What an incredible journey it has been! Once again, thank you so much, whether you're a veteran player or a new one. Thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and everything else! We owe all this success to you.

If you want to help us reach new heights, a positive review would mean a lot if you haven't already left one! You can also recommend the game to your friends.

Anyway, we hope you enjoy what the 1.0 version has to offer, and we are eager to hear your feedback!

Have fun, everyone!

notes.title: Early Access out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After much anticipation, it's time... [b]Shogun Showdown is out now in early access![/b]

We are extremely excited about this new release and deeply appreciate your ongoing support! ❤️
It's now the perfect moment to experience all the thrilling features that Shogun Showdown brings to the table, the game will be also available in a [b]bundle [/b]with [b]Shotgun King and Legend of Keepers[/b]!!

[previewyoutube=FzTDUy3D9uo;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access will include the following exciting new content:

- 3 playable characters
- 28 attack tiles
- 17 skills
- 24 quests
- 5 stamps per character with 2 ranks each
- 4 ascension levels
- 11 enemy-types, 9 bosses
- 9 combat locations
- 4 shop types, 12 tile upgrades, 6 consumables

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084000/Shogun_Showdown/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33360/TurnBased_Roguelike/

notes.title: Shogun Showdown Joins TactiCon 2023!
notes.content:
TactiCon brings together strategy game lovers. It's the perfect opportunity to discover Shogun Showdown, which we are showcasing on this event.


[h2]Don't miss the opportunity to add it to your wishlist!
[/h2]


While waiting for the game to be released, feel free to [b]check out the available prologue[/b] and get an idea of what's to come.


Get ready for the Japanese-inspired setting and pixel art, and gear up to fight the Shogun army!
